Learn About Our Server

{/* Server Information Section */}
{/* Server Overview */}
🏛️

Server Overview

Welcome to the most advanced Civilization V community! We combine competitive gaming with democratic governance, creating a unique experience where every citizen has a voice in how the server operates.

Core of Democraciv:

  • 🏛️ Democratic governance with elected Senators
  • 📊 ELO ranking system tracking all games
  • ⚖️ Justice system with citizen juries
  • 🔄 Crash recovery ensuring fair games
  • 🚫 Zero tolerance for rage quitting
  • 🎯 Competitive integrity enforcement

Community Structure:

  • 👥 Citizens vote on all major decisions
  • 🗳️ Elections every 2 months for leadership
  • 📜 Transparent rule-making process
  • � Community-driven server improvements
{/* Democratic Features */}
🗳️

Democratic Participation

Unlike other servers, you have a real voice here! Participate in elections, vote on legislation, and help shape the community's future.

Your Democratic Rights:

  • �️ Vote in Senate elections every 2 months
  • 📜 Vote on all new rules and legislation
  • ⚖️ Serve as juror in court trials
  • 🏛️ Run for Senate yourself
  • � Organize protests against government

How Democracy Works:

  • 👥 3 elected Senators create legislation
  • ✅ 66% citizen approval needed for laws
  • � Transparent voting in #elections
  • ⚖️ Democratic court system for justice
{/* Justice System */}
⚖️

Justice & Court System

Fair play is enforced through our democratic court system. Any rule violations are handled through transparent trials with citizen juries.

Court Process:

  • 🔍 Anyone can /sue for rule violations
  • 👥 12-citizen jury system
  • ⚖️ Senators serve as prosecution
  • 🏛️ Transparent trial in dedicated threads
  • 🎯 66% jury vote needed for conviction
  • 💡 Guilty plea reduces punishment by half

Punishment System:

  • 🥇 1st-3rd offense: 2 days prison
  • 🥈 4th-5th offense: 2 weeks prison
  • 🥉 6th+ offense: 2 months prison
  • 🔄 Clean slate after 6 months
{/* Legislation */}
�

Legislation System

All server rules are created and modified through our democratic legislation process. Senators propose laws, and citizens vote on them.

How Laws Are Made:

  • 📝 Senators propose new rules or edits
  • 🗳️ Requires 2/3 Senator approval first
  • 👥 Citizens then vote on legislation
  • ✅ 66% citizen approval needed to pass
  • 📋 All managed in #elections channel
{/* Justice System */}
⚖️

Justice & Enforcement

Rule violations are handled through democratic trials with citizen juries. Fair, transparent, and community-driven justice for all.

How Justice Works:

  • 🔍 Anyone can /sue rule violators
  • 👥 12-citizen jury decides guilt
  • ⚖️ Transparent trial process
  • 📊 Progressive punishment system
  • 🔄 6-month clean slate policy

Punishment Structure:

  • 🥇 1st-3rd offense: 2 days prison
  • 🥈 4th-5th offense: 2 weeks prison
  • 🥉 6th+ offense: 2 months prison
  • 💡 Guilty plea = 50% reduction
{/* Core Server Rules - Primary Focus */}

🎯 Core Server Rules - READ BEFORE JOINING

These rules are STRICTLY ENFORCED through our democratic court system. Violations result in prison time!

🏆

Victory Conduct

MANDATORY: Play for your own victory. No suiciding into neighbors or removing military to lose your capital.

⚖️ Violation = Court trial + Prison time
🚫

No Rage Quitting

ZERO TOLERANCE: You cannot quit once a game begins. Stay until elimination or victory.

⚖️ Automatic punishment for quitters
🤝

Fair Play

REQUIRED: No pregame collusion, exploits, cheats, or shift-moves. No EUI enhanced demographics.

⚖️ Cheating = Immediate trial
💬

Community Standards

Free speech valued. Harassment prohibited. No stream sniping or sharing private game info.

🛡️ Democratic community protection
⚖️

Rule Enforcement

All rule violations are handled through our democratic court system with 12-citizen juries. Punishments range from 2 days to 2 months in prison depending on offense history.

⚠️ There are no warnings - follow the rules or face trial!

Ready to Join Our Democratic Civilization?

By clicking below, you agree to follow all server rules and participate in our democratic community

{/* Final CTA */}

Ready to Join the Most Advanced Democraciv Community?

Experience Civilization V with democratic governance, fair play enforcement, and competitive ranking!

{/* Game Guide Section */}

🎮 How to Join Democraciv Games

Get set up and start playing competitive Civilization V matches

{/* Setup Steps */}
1

🚀 Join Discord Server

First, join our Discord server to access game lobbies and community features

2

🔧 Install Required Mods

Download and install the essential mods for competitive Democraciv play

{/* Important Installation Warning */}

⚠️ Important Installation Notes

  • 🚫 Remove all other mods except EUI before installing
  • 📁 Avoid nested folders - extract directly to the specified directories
  • 🔄 Easy removal: Simply delete the mod folders to uninstall
  • 💬 Find downloads in Discord #setup-help channel
{/* FishMap */}

🗺️ FishMap

by Giant Death Robot

Fishmap is the basic Pangaea but with strategic balance now guarantees 7 coal and 3 aluminium to ensure fairness.

📁 Installation: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Sid Meier's Civilization V\Assets\Maps
Unzip the contents into the Maps directory
{/* KEKMod */}

⚡ KEKMod v1.4

11.49 MB

Kekmod is designed for people who love BNW Civ. The changes are intended to improve gameplay, fix some bugs and simplify interaction between players.

� Installation: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Sid Meier's Civilization V\Assets\DLC
⚙️ Run Setup: ui_check.bat
Unzip contents to DLC directory, then run the batch file

📝 Download links and complete installation guides available in Discord #setup-help channel

3

🎯 Find & Join Lobbies

Go to #Draft channel to find or create new lobbies

How to Join Lobbies:

1. 📋 Find Lobbies: Go to #Draft channel to see available games
2. ✅ Join/Leave: Click the "Join/Leave" button to enter a lobby
3. 🚫 Ban Civilizations: Press "Bans Civs" button to ban your 2 required civilizations
4. 🎮 No Lobbies? Make One!: Press "Vanilla Lobby" or "Kekmod Lobby" button and set it up to your liking
4

🎯 Ready Up & Pick Your Civ

Once you've joined a lobby and banned civilizations, ready up and select your civilization

✅ Ready Button: Click ready when you're prepared to start
🏛️ Pick Civilization: Choose from the available civilizations
⏰ Wait for Others: Game starts when all players are ready
5

🔗 Post Steam Link to Join Game

Copy the steam link from the lobby and paste it in your browser to join the game

📋 Copy Link: Copy the steam://joinlobby link from Discord
🌐 Open Browser: Paste the link in your web browser
🎮 Join Game: Steam will automatically open and join the lobby
6

✅ Start Playing

Commit to finishing the entire game and enjoy competitive Civilization V

🔒 Commitment: No quitting once the game begins
📊 ELO Tracking: Your ranking will be updated
📹 Recording: Game will be automatically recorded
🔄 Crash Recovery: Available if technical issues occur
{/* Game Features */}

🌟

📊

ELO Ranking System

Track your competitive progress with detailed statistics and rankings

📹

Game Recording

All matches automatically recorded for review and dispute resolution

🔄

Crash Recovery

Technical issues won't ruin your game - we can restore and continue

⚖️

Fair Play Enforcement

Democratic justice system ensures all players follow the rules

{/* Final Game CTA */}

Ready to Start Playing?

Join our Discord server and begin playing in the biggest Democraciv community!

{/* Final Overall CTA */}
